title: Global Benefit Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Global Benefits Operations Manager, you will own benefits across EMEA, APAC, the US, and Canada, working with both our owned entities and EOR partners. You’ll keep our programs compliant and consistent across regions, advise on local requirements, and make sure our people feel supported at every stage.

This is a build role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and wants to shape a global benefits function from the ground up.

Responsibilities

EOR-to-Entity and PEO Transitions

- Lead the benefits workstream for moving countries from EORs to owned entities, partnering with Legal, Finance, and Payroll on plan establishment, statutory enrollments, and employee transition communications

- Lead the evaluation, vendor selection, and migration from our PEO to direct US benefits administration, including carriers, brokers, payroll and HRIS integration, and open enrollment readiness

- Manage EOR relationships and employees under EORs

Operations and Escalation

- Own benefits operations across enrollment, renewals, mid-year changes, and offboarding, with clear SLAs and reliable issue resolution

- Serve as the escalation point and advisor for complex benefits, leave of absence, and time off cases, partnering with Legal and brokers as needed

- Administer leave policies (parental, medical, disability) and coordinate them across jurisdictions

- Ensure benefits information is accurate, current, and consistent across the HRIS, benefits portal, intranet, and handbooks

- Design and improve benefits processes and policies so they are clear, scalable, and well documented

Compliance

- Ensure compliance with local benefits, insurance, and social security regulations in every operating jurisdiction, adapting practices as rules evolve

- Manage US federal and state compliance (ACA, ERISA, COBRA, Form 5500, nondiscrimination testing, state leave and benefits requirements) and Canadian federal and provincial requirements

- Flag emerging risks and partner with Legal and outside counsel on country-specific questions

WHAT YOU BRING

Required

- 5+ years of benefits experience

- Experience managing benefits in a hypergrowth or new-market-entry environment

- Strong working knowledge of US benefits (ACA, ERISA, COBRA, 401(k))

- Working knowledge of EMEA and/or APAC benefits and statutory requirements, with sound judgment on when to bring in local counsel or advisors

- Experience with PEOs and EORs

- Experience with HRIS and benefits administration platforms

Our Values

- 🤝 Collaborative Humans - Prioritizing collective intelligence

- 🚀 Fearless Innovators - Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

- 💪 Persistent, Passionate Developers - Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

- 🎯 Impact-Driven Creators - Crafting intuitive tools for developers

- 🧠 Rapid Learners and Un-learners - Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world

Quilter oversees £157.4 billion in customer investments (as of August 2026). It has an adviser and customer offering spanning financial advice, investment platforms, multi-asset investment solutions, and discretionary fund management. The business is comprised of two segments: Affluent and High Net Worth.

High Net Worth includes the discretionary fund management business, Quilter Cheviot, together with Quilter Cheviot Financial Planning - offering a highly personalised service to private clients, charities, trustees, and professional partners. Quilter Cheviot has presence throughout the UK, Ireland and Channel Islands.

At Quilter we never stand still. Our foundations are rooted in our extraordinary expertise, which is trusted by hundreds of thousands of customers, but we have great ambitions to stay one step ahead and make an even greater difference to the people and communities we serve, including our colleagues.

Our business is transforming, continually modernising, and becoming even more customer centric. So, if you want to be bold in the pursuit of your ambitions, bring new ideas, and challenge and evolve what we do, it’s the perfect time to join us! About the Role
Level : Level 4
Department: Supervision & Oversight (QFP)
Location : Home-based
Contract type : Permanent, Full-Time
As a Firm Compliance Partner within Quilter Financial Planning, you will provide regulatory oversight for a varied portfolio of appointed representative firms. Your portfolio will include routine firms and smaller bespoke businesses that are suitable for primarily remote supervision, with occasional travel where the circumstances or risk profile of a firm require it.
You will take end-to-end ownership of your firms, building effective working relationships with Firm Principals and developing a strong understanding of how their businesses operate. You will provide practical support and guidance while retaining the independence and confidence to challenge constructively where regulatory requirements or Network standards are not being met.
You will plan and complete firm attestation reviews and governance assessments, using evidence and professional judgement to assess each firm’s governance, systems and controls. Where concerns or weaknesses are identified, you will agree proportionate action plans, establish clear timescales and monitor progress through to completion.
You will take ownership of identified issues through to an appropriate conclusion, escalating material concerns through the relevant channels when required. You will also support the pre-vetting of firms looking to join Quilter , assessing compliance and conduct risks, providing appropriate challenge and contributing to informed onboarding decisions.
The decisions you make will directly support good customer outcomes by helping firms identify weaknesses early, strengthen their controls and deliver advice and ongoing service to the standards customers should expect.
This is a home-based role where supervision is delivered primarily through Microsoft Teams. You will plan and manage your own workload while contributing to a highly skilled and collaborative team.
Occasional travel will be required where this is appropriate to the needs of the firm or the supervision being undertaken.
About You
You will be a confident communicator, particularly skilled in questioning, and be able to display sound judgment when assessing risks and developing action plans. You will also have strong analytical approach and inquisitive nature.
You will bring a wealth of existing experience working within a compliance role and be competent in providing feedback to advisers/firm principals.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from legal practice, restructuring and insolvency, litigation support or legal operations, across disputes, insolvency, commercial or corporate matters, who build claims analyses, damages calculations and spend trackers in Excel. - Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

- 3+ years in legal practice, restructuring/insolvency, litigation support or legal operations, covering disputes, insolvency, commercial or corporate matters

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

Als GIS Consultant speel jij een sleutelrol in dit proces. Jij combineert jouw kennis van GIS met een scherp analytisch vermogen om onze klanten te helpen de beste resultaten te behalen.
Wat ga je doen?

• Advies en Implementatie: Je analyseert klantvragen, vertaalt deze naar pragmatische adviezen en ondersteunt implementatietrajecten van begin tot eind.

• Ontwikkeling van Geo-ICT Architecturen: Samen met ons ontwikkelteam werk je aan onderscheidende oplossingen en verbeter je continu onze Xchange4S-productsuite.

• Klantgericht Werken: Je fungeert als verbindende schakel tussen onze klanten en de ontwikkelaars, waarbij je oplossingen duidelijk presenteert en afstemt.

• Innovatie en Groei: Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere groei van Net4S door jouw expertise en ondernemende instelling in te zetten.

Requirements
Wat breng je mee?

• Een WO- of HBO-opleiding (of aantoonbaar werk- en denkniveau) met een link naar Geo of ICT.

• Minimaal enkele jaren relevante ervaring in het GIS-werkveld, met uitgebreide kennis van Esri-software.

• Basiskennis van Geo-ICT-architecturen en affiniteit met het beheer van complexe infrastructuren.

• Analytische vaardigheden en een passie voor het oplossen van complexe problemen.

• Sterke communicatieve en adviesvaardigheden; je kunt jouw ideeën helder overbrengen en klanten overtuigen.

• Ondernemerschap en een proactieve houding om impact te maken binnen een groeiende organisatie.

Benefits
Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een uitdagende rol: Werk bij een ambitieus, groeiend bedrijf waar jouw kennis en ideeën gewaardeerd worden.

• Ruimte voor ontwikkeling: Krijg toegang tot onze Net4S Academy, een opleidingsbudget en volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

• Flexibiliteit: Een fulltime functie met de mogelijkheid om parttime te werken, en de vrijheid om je eigen dagindeling te bepalen.

Moderne arbeidsvoorwaarden:

• Een marktconform salaris met uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden.

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving: Werk samen met ervaren collega’s en partners die je helpen groeien, en maak deel uit van een team dat elkaar inspireert en ondersteunt.

Waarom kiezen voor Net4S?
Bij Net4S werk je in een informele, energieke cultuur waar jouw ontwikkeling centraal staat. We combineren innovatie met persoonlijke aandacht en zorgen ervoor dat onze collega’s niet alleen het besteuit zichzelf halen, maar ook plezier hebben in hun werk. title: Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO)
description:
Position Overview
The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.
Key Responsibilities
ESG & Sustainability Strategy

• Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.

• Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.

• Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

• Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.

• Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.

• Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

• Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.

• Oversee corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs and social impact strategies.

• Promote ethical business practices and stakeholder trust.

Governance & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.

• Establish governance policies and sustainability reporting structures.

• Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and audit teams on ESG governance.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

• Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.

• Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.

• Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

• Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.

• Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.

• Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

• Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.

• Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.

• Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

• Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.

• Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.

• Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

• Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.

• Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.

• Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.

• Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.

• Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

• Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.

• Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

• Analytical and risk assessment abilities.

• Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

• Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.

• Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.

• ESG ratings and reporting complian

title: Finance Manager, FP&A
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As the FP&A Manager of Core Platform Business Unit Finance, you will drive financial strategy, resource allocation, and operational transformation across our highest-impact product organizations. In this high-visibility role, you will own cost governance across major OpEx and CapEx investments, partnering directly with R&D and senior finance leadership to optimize capital deployment and financial discipline. Rather than just reporting numbers, you will shape business outcomes by developing scalable financial models, automating analytical workflows, and delivering actionable performance insights that influence business performance and resource allocation decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Financial Ownership & Cost Control: Manage assigned OpEx and CapEx budgets, cost centers, and financial forecasts, driving monthly and quarterly close reconciliations and variance analyses to maintain financial discipline across business units.

• Planning & Strategic Forecasting: Lead near-term financial planning and P&L modeling to provide executive leadership with accurate performance projections, scenario analyses, and visibility into key cost drivers.

• Cross-Functional Business Partnership: Partner directly with business and functional managers to evaluate operational priorities, challenge budget assumptions, and deliver actionable financial insights that guide capital allocation decisions.

• Data Analytics & BI: Build, query, and maintain analytical frameworks using SQL, Snowflake, and Tableau to convert large operational datasets into automated, interactive executive dashboards.

• Process Transformation & AI Automation: Design and implement scalable FP&A process improvements, integrating AI technologies (e.g., ChatGPT workflows) to automate repetitive reporting tasks and accelerate close cycles.

• Operational Finance Integration: Oversee operational finance workflows, including procurement, accounts payable (A/P), accounts receivable (A/R), and invoicing processes, to ensure end-to-end data accuracy and audit-ready financial controls.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, California office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 5+ years of experience in progressively complex financial planning and analysis (FP&A) roles, with a proven track record of managing end-to-end forecasting in fast-paced environments.

• Advanced expertise in Excel/Google Sheets financial modeling.

• Curiosity and a proactive approach to optimizing operational efficiency by building better workflows.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and negotiation skills, with a demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships across technical, operational, and executive teams.

• Working knowledge of core financial accounting operations, including accounts payable (A/P), accounts receivable (A/R), and invoicing functions.

• Self-directed initiative and adaptability to manage multiple complex priorities independently in high-growth, evolving environments.

• Experience partnering with Research & Development teams is a plus.

• Familiarity with SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, or equivalent BI tools for data analysis is a plus.

• Familiarity with leveraging AI to improve processes and dashboarding is a plus.

title: Software Engineering LMTS / PMTS - Software Factory
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Software Engineering Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword - it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce 's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce .
Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We’re building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.

Following our acquisition by Salesforce , we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup-backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback, without layers of approvals slowing you down.

The Role

Software Factory is a brand-new team industrializing how we build software. We’re building the platform that lets coding agents do real work against our codebase: remote sandboxes where agents run our full build safely, the orchestration that kicks off that work from Slack, Linear, GitHub, and schedulers, and the observability that makes the output trustworthy at scale.

A deliberate choice shapes this team: we run the best off-the-shelf coding agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, and whatever comes next) rather than building our own. This team’s product is the factory around them: the sandboxes, triggers, context, review surfaces, and audit trails that turn raw agent capability into dependable engineering output for the whole org.

As a software engineer and one of the team’s first hires, you’ll shape that platform from the ground up while shipping to demanding internal customers from day one: every engineer at Qualified. You’ll partner closely with our CTO on everything the team builds, from architecture and build-vs-buy decisions to what the factory takes on next.

What You’ll Do

• Build triggers and orchestration that turn Slack messages, Linear tickets, GitHub events, and schedules into agent runs with concrete outcomes: PRs, preview environments, documents, and Slack replies

• Shape the context agents work with: the codebase and its history, Notion, Slack, Datadog, and integration twins for systems like Salesforce

• Build human-in-the-loop surfaces for reviewing and steering agent plans, artifacts, and code

• Evaluate and integrate a fast-moving ecosystem of sandboxes, orchestrators, and agents with sound build-vs-buy judgment

• Partner directly with our CTO to shape priorities, architecture, and what the factory takes on next

• Own delivery from design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

• Help set the patterns for how the entire engineering org works with agents day to day

Who You Are

• Hands-on with coding agents and LLM tooling (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar), with real opinions about where they shine and where they fail

• Proven experience building developer tooling, CI/CD systems, or platform infrastructure that other engineers depend on daily

• Build observability for agent work: traces, tool audit trails, and cost per execution, with sampling-based trace review like QC on a fa

title: Regional Sales Director - Upstate NY
description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone.  Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor.  Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit  https://mineralystx.com . Follow Mineralys on  LinkedIn ,  Twitter  and  Bluesky ”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

• Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake

• Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities

• Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond

• Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time

• Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

• Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region

• Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8-12 territory managers

• Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge

• Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact

• Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

• Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts

• Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies

• Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts

• timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution

• Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments

• Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions

• Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

• Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards

• Manage regional budgets and resources effectively

• Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline

• Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree pref

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll be our first GTM hire at T:0, building the sales engine from scratch with no existing playbook to follow. You’ll personally run outbound, triage inbound, take founders from first conversation to paying customer, and identify the channels that consistently create pipeline before we invest heavily in them.

You’ll own the CRM and sales process end to end, defining stages, keeping data clean, and building a pipeline the whole company can trust. You’ll sell to US-based seed-to-Series-A startups through a high-volume, low-friction motion designed to close quickly, while creating a clear path toward self-serve and PLG.

As the business grows, you’ll open new segments yourself, building longer and more considered sales motions alongside the fast one. You’ll generate your own pipeline in partnership with our Head of Marketing and work closely with Airwallex’s Startups team to keep both motions aligned and compounding.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.

Essentials

- You’ve built a sales motion, not just operated one someone else already proved out.

- You’ve sold across different deal shapes, including longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

- You’re the person who books the thing instead of just suggesting it. You can get a stranger on a call and leave with a yes, and you’d rather do something scrappy today than something perfect next week.

Preferred

- Experience selling fintech products, especially in accounting, bookkeeping, or the founder finance stack.

- Experience building and managing a CRM.

- Experience using AI to automate sales outbounding.

- You’re excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

- You default to action. You'd rather course-correct in motion than wait for perfect clarity.

- You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role

Lead Ocado's global fire safety governance and assurance framework, operating directly within the corporate Health, Safety, Fire, and Environmental (HSFE) function. In this role, you will evaluate fire risk through both life safety, property protection and business continuity perspectives, providing expert guidance, oversight, and constructive challenge to product engineering and operations teams. 

As the organisation's principal fire safety competent person, you will advise and influence senior stakeholders while contributing to the broader HSFE strategic agenda. 

Key Responsibilities 

• Owning the Group's fire safety standards, methodology and assurance approach, giving competent, independent advice and challenge across every operating territory.

• Operating as a second-line function: advising business operations and engineering functions on fire risk and legal compliance, testing the effectiveness of controls and holding first-line operations to account, without owning their decisions.

• Integrating fire risk into the Group's wider HSFE risk, governance and assurance framework.

• Providing specialist technical review of entry into new territories, and ensuring fire safety considerations are embedded into contract negotiations, design, project delivery, engineering and change from concept onwards.

• Advising the business on emerging thermal risks that come with robotic automation and scale, including lithium-ion battery systems, thermal events and high-bay environments.

• Leading the Group's external fire safety relationships with regulators, fire and rescue authorities, and 3rd party auditors

• Contributing breadth across the wider HSFE Governance function: shared governance frameworks, accountability models, competence and role definitions, committee structures and assurance approaches beyond fire alone.

About you

• Degree-level qualification in a relevant discipline (e.g. risk management, fire safety,or built-environment discipline), or an equivalent recognised professional qualification supported by demonstrable industry experience.

• Current professional membership, at a grade evidencing professional competence, of a recognised fire safety, risk management or related institution (e.g. Institute of Fire Safety Managers, Institution of Fire Engineers, Institute of Risk Management, or an equivalent body in a relevant operating territory).

• Experience of fire risk management in a relevant industrial setting, including at Group, multi-site and multi-jurisdictional level, with demonstrable strategic and commercial judgement in managing risk organisationally.

• Demonstrable competence to determine and oversee fire risk assessment methodology, standards and competent-person requirements, and to direct, commission and quality-assure specialist technical work (fire engineering, fire protection, fire risk assessment).

• Experience advising and influencing senior operational leaders on fire risk, translating complex technical issues into clear business-risk, decision-ready advice.

25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more - and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

• Family-first policies :

この職務を通してのバリュー

• TAは様々な業界のお客様と複雑で難易度の高いプロジェクトの最前線で支援活動を実施します。その活動を通じ、Tableauを含めたシステム全体での最適なアーキテクチャ・ソリューションを提供することで、お客様のビジネスおよびデジタルトランスフォーメーションを成功に導く経験を得られます。

title: AI Tutor - Amharic
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this role, you will help train and refine Grok's voice and language capabilities in Amharic. Your expertise will directly shape how Grok speaks and understands Amharic, from pronunciation and natural phrasing to cultural nuance. You will see your work show up in a product used by people around the world.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Annotate, label, and provide feedback on multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, and speech samples using proprietary tools.

• Translate and localize text (UI copy, prompts, responses, and other content) from English into Amharic, with attention to accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural fit.

• Help produce clear, natural audio data that accurately captures linguistic and prosodic details such as intonation, rhythm, and accent.

• Collaborate with technical staff to refine annotation guidelines and tools for handling accents, background noise, speech variation, and multilingual audio.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Proficiency in Amharic at CEFR C1 level or higher.

• English proficiency at CEFR B2 level or higher.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Native proficiency in Amharic.

• English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher.

• Experience in one or more of the following areas: 

• Advanced transcription or audio annotation, with strong attention to accents, prosody, disfluencies, and variable recording quality.

• Translation or localization work (especially UI, product copy, or conversational text) between English and Amharic.

• Voice recording, voice acting, podcasting, or related audio production that demonstrates clear delivery and attention to sound quality.

• Background in linguistics, phonetics, speech sciences, or hands-on work with speech/audio datasets and AI training data.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

• This is a remote role which may be performed from the following countries:

• United States

• United Kingdom

• Canada

• Australia

• This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position, depending on role / business needs and candidate availability. Full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone.

• Positions are typically offered as fixed-term employment contracts of 6 months. Extensions or conversion to a permanent role may be available based on business needs.

• For US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time.

• We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.

• Travel to a SpaceXSI site may be required.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US-based candidates: $35/hour - $45/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible US-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Singapore
description:
WHO WE ARE

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality.

You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab.

The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next.

Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder.

Five years from now, FDE at Roboflow on a resume should mean what a few years at Palantir or a FAANG company means. That's the bar we're hiring against.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- 0-to-1 Deployment: Take validated proof-of-concepts from the pre-sales process and build the first production deployment. This includes data pipeline setup, model optimization, edge device configuration, and integration with customer infrastructure.

- Edge-First Engineering: Deploy and operate computer vision systems on edge hardware in physical environments. Where conditions are unpredictable and connectivity is unreliable. This is hands-on, hardware-heavy work.

- Embed with Customers: Work on-site or deeply embedded with the customer’s engineering team during the initial deployment phase (typically 4-12 weeks per engagement). Build trust, transfer knowledge, and establish the foundation for long-term success.

- Production Engineering: Write production-grade code that will live in the customer’s environment. Handle the messy realities of real-world computer vision: lighting variability, camera calibration, model drift, network latency, and edge hardware constraints.

- Be Our Eyes and Ears in the Field: You'll be closer to the customer's real problems

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We are looking for a Head of Capital and Liquidity Planning to lead Teya’s first-line prudential framework and help ensure that our growth is supported by robust capital, liquidity and risk management.

Reporting to the CFO, you will own the practical delivery of Teya’s prudential agenda across capital adequacy, liquidity adequacy, stress testing, ICAAP, ILAAP and contingency planning. You will work closely with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Product and Operations to turn prudential requirements into clear decisions, effective controls and usable management information.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Overview

The Technical Trainer is responsible for planning and delivering training programs that enable warehouse teams to effectively use the Warehouse Management System. This role develops training materials, schedules training sessions, and ensures operators and supervisors understand system workflows. The Technical Trainer also supports go-live activities and conducts process audits to ensure operational adherence to system processes

Responsibilities

Training Planning & Delivery

• Develop and manage training schedules for WMS implementations and system enhancements

• Deliver instructor-led and hands-on training for warehouse operators, supervisors, and super users

• Coordinate training sessions with site leadership and project teams

• Facilitate classroom and floor-based training sessions

Training Content Development

• Create and maintain user guides, job aids, and process documentation

• Develop role-based training materials for different warehouse functions (receiving, picking, packing, shipping, inventory)

• Determines utilization and validates documentation through testing systems.

• Update training content as system changes or enhancements are introduced

• Support creation of simulation scenarios in training environments

• Report training metrics related to systems training, such as satisfaction, completion rates, learner retention.

Go-Live Training Support

• Support WMS implementations through onsite training and floor support

• Assist operators and supervisors in executing system workflows during initial adoption

• Address training-related questions and provide immediate coaching

Process Compliance & Audits

• Assess learners’ retention of learning and ensure they are able to apply their knowledge to their everyday use of the technical systems. Measure the effectiveness of the training.

• Conduct process enforcements during go-live and stabilization phases

• Ensure operational teams are following defined WMS processes and scanning procedures

• Identify process gaps and provide corrective coaching

• Escalate training or process issues to project leadership

Collaboration

• Partner with operations, IT, and implementation teams to align training with system configuration

• Support superuser development at warehouse sites

• Promote user knowledge sharing of the technical systems through the use of our social collaboration tool.

• Maintain and continuously improve the training program and resources.

• Maintains technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing publications.

Qualifications

title: Senior Security Researcher

About Us
AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

AutoLeap is the market-leading shop management SaaS provider in the underserved auto repair industry. The Shop Management System (SMS) provides an all-in-one, cloud-based auto repair management software that helps after-market auto shop owners focused on general repair to better understand, manage, and grow their business-from scheduling appointments to managing technicians and generating invoices to help save time and money.
In 2023, we announced our $30m Series B led by Advanced Venture Partners (AVP) and aren’t slowing down. Our mission is to change the auto repair industry one shop at a time, helping shop owners get home to their families earlier and helping them build long-lasting healthy businesses to pass on to future generations. We will be the de facto choice for all shop owners looking to grow and improve their businesses with your help!
As a Technical Marketing Manager you will own the:

•
Team: manage the PPC Team and SEO Team day-to-day workload, performance, goals and be accountable for outcomes across a large portfolio of client accounts.

•
Cadence: run regular 1:1s, weekly team check-ins, and client facing touchpoints so every account gets consistent attention.

•
Process/Automation: continuously look for ways to reduce manual work through better workflows, reporting, and automation, including the use of AI tools

•
Cross-functional Coordination : work alongside the Onboarding, Web and Social Team on shared accounts and client needs.

•
Reporting: keep team performance and account health tracked and reported on a regular cadence.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

• 5+ years of hands-on, working experience in both PPC and SEO, someone who can go deep on either side.

• 2+ years leading or managing a team, ideally in an agency, in-house local marketing services, or multi-account environment.

• To be Comfortable working with call tracking tools, local SEO management platforms (e.g. BrightLocal), and PPC management tools.

• To be Comfortable using AI tools as part of the regular workflow for reporting, content, or process efficiency.

• To be Someone who instinctively looks to systemize and automate repetitive work rather than absorb it.

• To be someone with local services ads, small businesses, or SaaS marketing experience.

• To Have a Positive, can-do attitude and brings energy to the table.

• To have Collaborative mindset: works well across PPC, SEO, onboarding, and web, not just within your own lane.

• To be Hands-on with strong attention to detail, comfortable in the weeds when it matters.

• Growth-at-all-cost focus: always looking for the next lever to pull for clients and for the team, never settling for “good enough.”

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience building and managing a team from the ground up.

• Location/Time Zone: Candidates must be able to consistently work within Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours.

What Success in this role looks like:

• Growth in the number of accounts managed, high client satisfaction, and improved retention.

• Reporting and account management increasingly automated, less time on manual work, more time on strategy and clients.

• A regular meeting and check-in cadence running across the team, with strong client relationships as a result.

title: VP Product
description:
About Current AI
Current AI
is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.
If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.
Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.
Role Overview
Our main product umbrella at Current AI is AI Potluck:, an open source project to build a vertically integrated and easy to use AI product assembled entirely out of open source components and built collaboratively with the open source ecosystem.
As VP Product and reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the overall product strategy and product management organization for Current AI. You will own AI Potluck end to end: Alpha, our open source alternative to the closed AI assistants most people use today, the Gap Map, our insights product that shows the open source ecosystem where attention is needed, and the products that come after. You will partner with the Head of engineering and executive leadership to translate vision into scalable roadmaps and PRDs, running the product lifecycle from inception to launch. The goal is movement building through product, so the technology is the means and the measure is whether people and organizations adopt what we ship and contribute back to it. You will define what makes AI Potluck unique and why people should join the movement.
What you will be working on
AI Potluck has three parts today, and you will own all of them:

• Alpha, at , an assistant assembled entirely from open source components, launched in July 2026 at AI for Good in Geneva and in open testing since.

• The Gap Map, at , which shows where the open source AI ecosystem has gaps and where funding and contribution should go.

• The Alpha Public Router, a single endpoint serving models from public and mission aligned suppliers. It powers Alpha today and becomes a product for developers next.

Your first six months

• Take Alpha from testing to real everyday use inside a small number of partner organisations.

• Decide what the Public Router becomes as a product, and what we ask developers to do with it.

• Set the 2027 roadmap with partners and grantees.

• Increase our partners’ contributions on Alpha

How we will measure success

• Products shipped on the dates we announce publicly.

• Organisations actively using Alpha and the Router, not only registered.

• Open source projects integrated into the stack, and contributions we send back to them.

• Partners who move from a conversation to a shipped integration.

• A roadmap that partners can read without needing a meeting to understand it.

What you’ll do
The VP Product will be responsible for the following:
Product Strategy & Vision

• Lead the overall product vision and strategy, translating organizational mission into compelling product designs while prioritizing interoperability and completeness of the broader ecosystem stack over in-house build.

• Own the global product roadmap, bringing technical options, trade-offs, and strategic recommendations directly to the C

description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. title: Enterprise Account Executive - Platform Clients
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 https://www.g2.com/products/tremendous/reviews.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees: our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

As our Enterprise Account Executive, Platform Clients, you will sell to software companies that embed Tremendous into their own product so their customers can send rewards and payouts. Think employee recognition tools, loyalty and referral platforms, affiliate and creator networks. One platform integration brings dozens or hundreds of end clients onto Tremendous, which is why these are valuable and profitable deals.

This is not a rewards API sale. You are selling a partnership: a new feature for their product, a new revenue line for their business, and a payouts expert they don't have to build in-house. The buyer is usually a Product Manager, an engineering lead, or a founder, and the deal doesn't close when the contract is signed. It closes when their integration is live and their end clients are sending rewards.

Platform deals run long (6 to 18 months is normal) and then compound. Several of our best platform clients started as five-figure conversations and now run millions in annual volume. You'll own a book of these and be the quarterback for each one from first call through end client activation.

This role is roughly 70% new logo and 30% expansion. You're primarily a hunter, but every platform you land becomes an account you grow by helping them onboard more end clients.

What you'll do:

- Hunt across the platform landscape. Build a target list of software companies in our proven sub-segments and beyond, segment it by fit and end client count, and go after it deliberately with your SDR partner. Many of your best prospects don't offer payouts today; your pitch is that they should.

- Sell the partnership, not the product. Lead with the prospect's pain and their product roadmap. Size every deal by what sits behind it: how many end clients, net-new vs. migrating existing ones, what they use for payouts today. Structure economics (standard pricing first, rebates and incentives when the deal needs them) with Deal Desk.

- Work hand in hand with Partnerships and Solutions Engineering. Platform deals are a team sport. You’ll partner closely with our Partnerships team on strategy, positioning, and commercial structure, and with Solutions Engineering on scoping and the technical build. You bring them in early, keep them in the loop as the deal evolves, and make sure nothing gets lost between selling, building, and go-live. Clear communication and a genuine instinct for cross-functional teamwork matter as much here as closing skill.

title: VP Sales
description:
COMPANY

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a VP Sales to lead new business development with government and large space sector customers. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thrives on winning major contracts personally, not just directing a team from a distance.

You bring deep, current knowledge of the satellite sales landscape, a track record of closing significant contracts, and the seniority to represent NewOrbit at the highest level with strategic customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Win and close contracts: Lead high-value deals with governments and large space organisations, from first conversation through to signature.

- Own the full sales cycle: Sourcing, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close - across every stage.

- Build strategic relationships: Develop and maintain senior-level relationships across government agencies, primes, and major operators.

- Set commercial strategy: Shape and execute NewOrbit's sales approach for government and enterprise customers.

- Represent NewOrbit externally: Executive-level presence at customer meetings, government engagements, and industry events.

- Partner internally: Work closely with engineering and delivery teams to scope deals that are commercially sound and deliverable.

- Report to leadership: Own pipeline, forecasting, and deal status reporting to the board.

- Grow the function: Build out a wider sales team as the business scales.

FUNDAMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

- Satellite sales experience (required): Direct, hands-on experience selling satellites specifically, across the full sales process. Current, up-to-date knowledge of the satellite customer landscape.

- Deal track record: Demonstrated history of winning significant (single-digit million £) contracts with large space organizations and/or governments.

- Seniority: Minimum 10 years in space industry sales; realistically 15-20+ years. This is a senior hire.

- Career focus: Majority, ideally the entirety, of your career spent in the space industry.

- Relationship-led approach: A strong, established professional network across government, primes, and major operators, built through years of direct engagement in the sector.

WHY NEWORBIT SPACE?

- Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

- Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

- Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

- Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

- Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

- Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security & DevSecOps Engineer to strengthen the security of our AWS infrastructure and applications within a growing B2B iGaming technology environment.
This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can identify vulnerabilities, implement security controls, automate processes and improve infrastructure resilience. The focus is on building a proactive security framework and embedding security throughout development and deployment operations.
Key Responsibilities

• Assess and secure AWS environments, including IAM, VPC, EC2, ECS, Fargate, RDS and S3.

• Identify and remediate vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and potential security risks.

• Implement AWS security services such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, CloudTrail, WAF and KMS.

• Strengthen access controls, encryption, secrets management and network security.

• Introduce automated vulnerability scanning, threat detection and security monitoring.

• Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines, including code, dependency, secrets and container scanning.

• Secure Docker containers, cloud workloads, APIs and deployment environments.

• Improve infrastructure hardening, patch management, backups and disaster recovery security.

• Develop incident response procedures, security alerts and remediation processes.

• Maintain security policies and support audits and compliance requirements.

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience in Cloud Security, DevSecOps or Infrastructure Security.

• Strong hands-on AWS security experience and knowledge of IAM, VPC, encryption and cloud architecture.

• Experience securing Linux servers, Docker containers, EC2, ECS and Fargate.

• Practical experience implementing security automation within CI/CD pipelines.

• Knowledge of vulnerability management, threat detection and incident response.

• Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools.

• Python, Bash or similar scripting skills.

• Good understanding of web and API security, including OWASP Top 10.

• Ability to independently assess risks and implement practical security solutions.

Nice to Have

• AWS Security Specialty certification or equivalent.

• Experience in iGaming, FinTech, Payments or other high-traffic transactional environments.

• Knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS.

• Experience with Kubernetes, SIEM platforms and security monitoring tools.

• Familiarity with penetration testing and security assessment methodologies.

First 90 Days

• First 30 days: Assess AWS infrastructure, identify security gaps and deliver a prioritised remediation plan.

• Days 31-60: Address critical vulnerabilities, strengthen access controls and introduce security automation.

• Days 61-90: Establish continuous monitoring, improve incident response and deliver a longer-term security roadmap.

What We're Looking For
A proactive, hands-on engineer who can take ownership of cloud security improvements from assessment through implementation. This is not a purely advisory or compliance-focused role; we need someone capable of designing solutions, implementing controls, automating security processes and continuously improving infrastructure protection.

title: Lead Product Manager, Access Management
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

The Opportunity

Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software.

Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting.

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person.

We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. You will work with a dedicated designer, an engineering manager, and a dedicated engineering team.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

The access model and administrator interfaces: get the core concepts right

• Own users, groups, credentials, access levels, door associations, and schedules. This is the conceptual core of the product, and getting it right is the difference between an admin who trusts the system and one who works around it

• Own the administrative interfaces and experience across web and mobile: bulk operations, search, and review flows that stay fast when a customer has 200,000 users and 10,000 doors

• Own visitor access, including how guests are invited, credentialed, and expired

Provisioning and integrations: let the system run itself

• Own the API and integration surface. Most large customers want access to follow their identity provider and HR system automatically, so joiners, movers, and leavers are handled without anyone touching our UI

• Partner with Verkada's Core team to drive identity integration: SCIM provisioning, SSO, directory sync, and the mapping between an HR record and what a door actually does

Agents and natural language: let admins state intent

• Define how agents fit into access management. An admin should be able to say what they want and have the system propose the configuration that satisfies it
